payload.comment: Training stage is internally consistent and properly executed. Key verifications: (1) Early stopping is correct — best_epoch=11, patience=3, stopped at epoch 14 (exactly 3 epochs without improvement: epochs 12/13/14 all below 0.997201). (2) Cosine LR schedule is numerically consistent: epoch-14 LR ≈ 1.09e-05 matches the expected cosine decay from 1e-3 over 15 epochs. (3) Config hash f770eaa3… is identical across best_configuration, search_report, and the trial artefact. (4) Augmented train size 359984 = 89996 × 4 (identity + hflip + vflip + rotate90) is arithmetically correct. (5) train_stats_only=true and test_locked=true confirm no test leakage. (6) The large gap between search val_acc (0.9827, 2 epochs) and final best_val_acc (0.9972, 14 epochs) is expected given the 7× increase in training time. Minor documentation notes: rationale strings are truncated with '…' in several artefacts, limiting full auditability; early_stopping_patience was raised from 1 (search) to 3 (final) without an explicit justification line, though the change is reasonable for 15 epochs. Neither issue affects numerical correctness or selection validity. No deterministic findings were raised. Ready to proceed to the next stage.
